# The Story of Mathematics

> > A comprehensive educational resource covering mathematical concepts from basic algebra to advanced calculus, featuring step-by-step guides, theorem explanations, and historical context for mathematical thought.

The Story of Mathematics provides accessible explanations of mathematical topics ranging from foundational algebra and geometry to calculus and mathematical analysis. The site emphasizes practical problem-solving techniques, theorem applications, and clear conceptual understanding for students and learners at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Calculus and derivatives
- Rolle's Theorem
- Mean Value Theorem
- Rational Root Theorem
- Side Splitter Theorem
- Cavalieri's Principle
- Squeeze Theorem
- Alternating Series Estimation Theorem
- Vertical Line Test
- BODMAS and PEMDAS
- Slope calculation and linear functions
- Integral calculus and antiderivatives
- Geometry and coordinate systems
- Mathematical analysis and continuity
- Beginner algebra fundamentals

## Calculus Fundamentals

- [Rolle's Theorem – Explanation and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/rolles-theorem): Rolle's Theorem proof and relation to Mean Value Theorem in calculus
- [How to Find the Slope of a Function - A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/how-to-find-the-slope-of-a-function): Step-by-step guide to calculating slope using rise-over-run formula
- [How to Find Asymptotes of a Function - Your Easy Guide to Graph Analysis](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/how-to-find-asymptotes-of-a-function): Guide to identifying horizontal and vertical asymptotes in functions
- [How to Find Real Zeros of a Function - A Simple Guide to Roots](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/how-to-find-real-zeros-of-a-function): Guide to finding function roots using Rational Root Theorem and factoring
- [Which Relation Is Not a Function? Explanation and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/which-relation-is-not-a-function): Distinguishing functions from relations using Vertical Line Test
- [Range of Square Root Function - Understanding its Limits and Behavior](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/range-of-square-root-function): Square root function range, domain, and behavior with interval notation

## Advanced Calculus Topics

- [Absolute Value Limits - Definition, Properties, and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/absolute-value-limits): Absolute value limits with Squeeze Theorem and continuity properties
- [Monotonic Sequence - Definition and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/monotonic-sequence): Monotonic sequences: definition, convergence, and boundedness properties
- [Alternating Series Estimation Theorem - Definition With Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/alternating-series-estimation-theorem): Alternating Series Estimation Theorem for error approximation bounds
- [Derivative of secant Inverse - Definition and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/derivative-of-secant-inverse): Derivative of inverse secant function with calculus examples
- [Exploring the Antiderivative of tan(x) - Applications and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/antiderivative-of-tan-x): Antiderivative of tan(x) with integration examples and applications

## Geometry and Theorems

- [Cavalieri's Principle - Definition, Conditions and Applications](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/cavalieri-principle): Cavalieri's Principle: volume relationships in solid geometry
- [Side Splitter Theorem - Rules, Application and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/side-splitter-theorem): Side Splitter Theorem: proportional segments in triangle geometry
- [Find the Area of the Shaded Region of a Circle: Clear Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/find-the-area-of-the-shaded-region-of-a-circle): Examples of calculating shaded region areas in circles using sector formulas
- [Quadrilateral Square - Definition, Properties, and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/quadrilateral-square): Square quadrilateral definition, properties, and formulas
- [3D Rectangle - Definition, Applications, and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/3d-rectangle): 3D rectangle (cuboid) definition with volume and surface area formulas

## Algebra Fundamentals

- [What is X in Algebra - Unveiling the Mystery of the Unknown Variable](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/what-is-x-in-algebra): Beginner guide explaining the unknown variable 'x' in algebraic equations
- [Bodmas vs Pemdas - Definition, Applications, and Examples](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/bodmas-vs-pemdas): BODMAS vs PEMDAS: comparing order of operations across regions

## Optional

- [Is Business Calculus Hard? Unraveling the Complexity for Beginners](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/is-business-calculus-hard): Assessing business calculus difficulty with success strategies for beginners
- [What Does 'Interpret' Mean in Math? Deciphering the Numbers](https://www.storyofmathematics.com/what-does-interpret-mean-in-math): Understanding mathematical interpretation in data analysis and word problems
